answer: Proof of Agent networks bind identities to hardware-rooted cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint reputation, agents solve proof-of-useful-work to extract network rewards—the economic nectar of the ecosystem. Sybil swarms targeting this verification haven face exponential capital exhaustion, as each cloned node requires unique enclave-bound stakes and a verifiable zero-knowledge cipher proof, rendering large-scale spoofing mathematically and economically unfeasible.
